description: An indented ${~ in a heredoc removes the indentation but not the previous newline
notes: The spec says a strip marker removes the spaces adjacent to it in the literal, "interpreted as per Unicode's definition". Under the White_Space reading that hashicorp/hcl uses, line breaks count, so all of "\n  " would go and the result would be "ab\n". hashicorp/hcl scans each heredoc line as a separate literal token (the heredocLiteralEOL action in hclsyntax/scan_tokens.rl), and parseTemplateParts in hclsyntax/parser_template.go trims only the one token next to the marker, before meldConsecutiveStringLiterals joins the lines, so the whitespace in the neighboring line's token is kept.
